context:
Goal: no session can forge your saved answer on the waiting page.
Problem (rule): the guard refuses set, update and str_replace on an answer, but lets a session delete one, which the decision's words do not allow.
Based on (read): skill waiting-page, "Route and close", deletes each routed answer; a delete writes no false answer.
Departs from: main has no answer guard — adds one that refuses writes to answers, with or without deletes.
home: step answers-session-write-guard (a session cannot forge your page answers)

options.gain: Routing and reopening keep working; no forged answer can be written.
options.how: The guard refuses set, update and str_replace on answers; a delete passes. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
options.label: Allow a delete
options.lose: A stray delete of your answer is not stopped; you would save it again.

options.gain: Your saved answer can never vanish by a session's act.
options.how: Every session write to answers is refused, a delete included; the page writer types override to route or reopen.
options.label: Refuse a delete too (Recommended)
options.lose: Each route or reopen needs an override.

ref: lane answers-session-write-guard, head 53e065d31, via coordinator 14:11 CST Nov 12
title: The answer guard lets a session delete a saved answer, or refuses that too
why: The decision text says the guard refuses every session write to answers; a delete is a write.
